column3: BSB renders “on behalf of all men” as “for everyone” and adds “be offered.”
Close to the Greek; “there is” is supplied twice.
BSB adds “that was given” to the phrase “the testimony at its own times.”
BSB follows the critical text without “in Christ,” moves “I am telling the truth” to the end, and renders “in faith and truth” as “faithful and true.”
BSB adds “I want” and lists “with modesty, and with self-control” separately.
BSB moves “with good deeds” forward and renders “professing godliness” as “profess to worship God.”
BSB adds “she is to remain”; the Greek says “but to be in quietness.”
BSB adds “it was … who” to emphasize the contrast and renders “has come into transgression” as “fell into transgression.”
BSB renders “she will be saved” as “Women … will be saved.”
